reason_for_abandonment: v2.8 completed Phase B and internally reconciled its scientific outputs, but final red-team review proved that completed-lifecycle validation did not reopen and bind the standalone validated-candidate identity and independent-reconciliation artifacts. An internally valid substituted standalone validated-candidate identity was accepted when embedded lifecycle evidence remained internally consistent.
